response.sql: WITH stats AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () as total_telescopes FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), with_shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / total_telescopes as share, AVG(CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / total_telescopes) OVER () as avg_share FROM stats) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - avg_share as gap FROM with_shares WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Only observatories that have at least one telescope are considered. Observatories in the observatories table with no associated telescopes are excluded from both the group counts and the average share calculation.

alternatives.interpretation: Include all observatories from the observatories table in the calculation, even those with zero telescopes. These observatories would contribute zero telescopes and a share of 0 to the average.
alternatives.sql: WITH stats AS (SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) as telescope_count, SUM(COUNT(t.telescregistry)) OVER () as total_telescopes FROM observatories o LEFT JOIN telescopes t ON o.observstation = t.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation), with_shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, CASE WHEN total_telescopes = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / total_telescopes END as share, AVG(CASE WHEN total_telescopes = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CAST(telescope_count AS REAL) / total_telescopes END) OVER () as avg_share FROM stats) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - avg_share as gap FROM with_shares WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY gap DESC LIMIT 10;
